descripcion: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the TLV.AUTH parser of the NSE eigrp.lua library, whose length arithmetic cancels out the running read position. Nmap before 7.992 contains an excessive memory allocation vulnerability in the unmarshall_array function of the NSE msrpctypes.lua library, which trusts the entry count declared by the server. A malicious SMB server on a scanned host can declare an EntriesRead value of 0xFFFFFFFF with an empty buffer, causing a prolonged CPU spin and exhausting the memory of the Nmap process; the library is used by smb-enum-shares.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A). 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:P/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H Gravedad 4.0 7.10 Gravedad 4.0 txt HIGH Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the inline AXFR response reader of the dns-zone-transfer.nse script, which reads the zone transfer response without a size limit. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data over TCP port 53 after the AXFR request, causing the memory of the Nmap process to grow at the attacker's send rate until it is exhausted. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:P/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H Gravedad 4.0 6.00 Gravedad 4.0 txt MEDIUM Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the process_write function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose write loop does not advance when it processes a malformed Repeat to Address (RA) order. A malicious TN3270 server on a scanned host can embed a single 6-byte malformed RA order in an ordinary screen-write data stream after a normal negotiation, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:P/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H Gravedad 4.0 6.00 Gravedad 4.0 txt MEDIUM Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the dispatcher of the NSE tftp.lua library, which removes completed coroutines but not ones that ended in an error, leaving a zero-yield spin. A malicious TFTP exchange reached by snmp-ios-config.nse after an SNMP write sequence can leave a dead coroutine that freezes the entire Nmap invocation, before port scanning begins for any target in the run; the hang is prevented when the script-timeout option is set. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:P/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H Gravedad 4.0 6.00 Gravedad 4.0 txt MEDIUM Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

Nmap before 7.992 contains a hardcoded cryptographic key vulnerability in the DHCAST128 login of the NSE afp.lua library, which uses a fixed, publicly known Diffie-Hellman private exponent. A passive observer of the network traffic between Nmap and an Apple Filing Protocol server can compute the shared secret from the hardcoded exponent and the server's public value and decrypt the password supplied to scripts such as afp-showmount.nse and afp-brute.nse through the afp.username and afp.password arguments, without man-in-the-middle access or cryptanalysis. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:P/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N Gravedad 4.0 6.00 Gravedad 4.0 txt MEDIUM Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

Nmap before 7.992 contains a loop with an unreachable exit condition in the parameter-list parsing of the NSE drda.lua library, which keeps growing its parameter list while processing a malicious DRDA response. Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the http-cisco-anyconnect.nse script and the anyconnect.lua library, whose redirect handler follows a server-supplied redirect target without checking that it stays on the scanned host. A malicious web server on a scanned host can redirect Nmap to an arbitrary host and port, including internal and loopback addresses the attacker cannot reach directly, making Nmap send a HEAD request followed by a POST request there; response content is not returned to the attacker. The script runs in the default script category (-sC, -A). 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:P/VC:N/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:L/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:N/I:L/A:N Gravedad 4.0 5.30 Gravedad 4.0 txt MEDIUM Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 4.70 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the ConfCreateResponse GCC block parser of the NSE rdp.lua library, which does not check that each block advances the read position. A malicious RDP server on a scanned host can include a single malformed zero-length block in an otherwise valid handshake, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process that the script-timeout option does not interrupt; the library is used by rdp-enum-encryption.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A). 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:P/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H Gravedad 4.0 7.10 Gravedad 4.0 txt HIGH Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM
